material_news_signals.headline: Lions-Bills on 'Thursday Night Football': What We Learned from Buffalo's 41-31 win
material_news_signals.description: Josh Allen and the Buffalo Bills opened the new Highmark Stadium with a 41-31 victory over the Detroit Lions on Thursday night.
material_news_signals.body_text: the house that josh built open for business new highmark stadium opened its doors for its first official bills home game and josh allen opened the floodgates allen captained his bills to a statement making 85 yard touchdown drive to open the festivities sneaking in from a yard out for the first score in the venue he followed with the first second and fourth td passes in the stadium s one night chronicle racking up four total tds in one half s worth of work looking every bit like a man on a mission just getting started allen s arm was strong and the bills run game was mighty in that opening half allen threw for three scores and 164 yards while rushing for 40 more as lead partner in crime james cook topped 100 yards before halftime head coach joe brady s offense rolled over the lions defense by air and ground piling up 299 total net yards to earn a 27 7 advantage at intermission when detroit opened the second half with a score allen emphatically answered commanding a 75 yard drive with the rebuttal of a 2 yard td run at evening s end allen had 248 yards and three tds on 20 of 31 passing to go with a pair of td runs and 69 yards on the ground it was the bills superstar s fourth game with three plus passing and two plus rushing touchdowns joining kordell steward as the only players in nfl history with multiple such games a master of ceremonies for a grand opening of the new highmark allen is playing like a quarterback possessed with super bowl aspirations lions are sacrificial lambs just four days after outlasting the saints for an overtime win there was no rest for the weary lions detroit was at the wrong end of a first half blowout credit to dan campbell s squad for failing to go gently into the western new york night but the bills kept their foot on the gas and the lions just looked gassed for much of the game the first half really before seemingly getting a second wind when it was already too late jared goff was sacked on an opening drive three and out and then fumbled twice before a second drive punt by the time goff hit jahmyr gibbs for an 11 yard touchdown the lions were already down 21 points it might just be as simple as the lions being in the wrong place at the wrong time in this one facing a jacked up josh allen and buffalo squad who wouldn t be denied on such a night that s the hope anyway rb battle goes to qb this was a matchup featuring two of the top running backs in the game today but the night belonged to a quarterback over his first 11 carries into the final quarter allen had 72 yards 6 5 per carry two touchdowns and three runs of 10 plus yards perhaps most impressive was his 100 success rate allen s rumbles have guided the bills to success for years and did again on thursday still the cook gibbs matchup wasn t without its merit cook had 101 yards in the first half and 135 with a touchdown for the game robin to allen s batman gibbs had his moments but overall he was held in check 16 carries for 52 yards and this performance could be seen as worrisome in week 1 gibbs had 33 touches five days later he had 22 more why he and goff were still in the game trailing by 17 points with less than three minutes to go is also a valid quandary thursday s loss shouldn t sully the lions high hopes for 2026 but detroit isn t going anywhere without its bell cow gibbs just need to make a decision on how much they can ring that bell rousseau emerging as force through two games 2021 first rounder gregory rousseau has four sacks he s clearly flourishing under new defensive coordinator jim leonhard groot is already halfway to his season high of eight sacks 2022 2024 rousseau had a game best six qb pressures on thursday night per next gen stats as the never quit mantra of the lions led to final stats that didn t really indicate a dominant buffalo defensive performance bradley chubb 1 5 sacks christian benford eight tackles two pass breakups rousseau and the bunch were impressive giving up 31 points two straight weeks looks problematic but this was a blowout in which the losing squad kept swinging holding the lions to a miniscule 66 rushing yards and 4 of 11 on third down is something to hang your helmet on all the more striking was it was done without ed oliver as the standout defensive tackle was ruled out after he injured his hip in pregame but the bills had rousseau who has shot out of the 2026 blocks and is finding his stride in his sixth season detroit d has been dreadful in the season opener the lions escaped with a 31 30 overtime win on thursday detroit was ambushed from the start and never really recovered they were vastly different games but a porous defense has been a two game constant aidan hutchinson one sack four qb pressures has all world talent and the potential to be a defensive player of the year candidate but defensive coordinator kelvin sheppard s unit needs to get better in a hurry it needs to get healthy too but safeties brian branch and kerby joseph are still on the shelf for at least two more games so sheppard must do what he can with what he s got so far that s not nearly been good enough the bills scored touchdowns on six of their nine drives punting twice and ending the game with a kneel over the opening two weeks detroit has ceded a mind spinning 71 points 915 total yards and 63 first downs the latter tied for second most by any team through two games since 1950 not great next gen stats insight for lions bills via nfl pro the buffalo offense featured 13 personnel on 20 plays against the lions its second straight game with 20 plays with three tight ends nfl research joe brady became the first head coach in bills history to start his career 2 0 buffalo has had 20 previous head coaches including interim

material_news_signals.headline: Emmitt Smith believes Ravens' Derrick Henry can break his all-time rushing record
material_news_signals.description: Common logic suggests running backs usually age out of peak effectiveness by their 30th birthday. Common logic doesn't apply to Derrick Henry, says Emmitt Smith.
material_news_signals.body_text: common logic suggests running backs usually age out of peak effectiveness by their 30th birthday common logic doesn t apply to derrick henry the 32 year old rushed for 3 516 yards and 32 touchdowns in his age 30 and 31 seasons and racked up 144 yards and three touchdowns on 24 carries in week 1 he s officially an ageless wonder at running back and has history in his sights at 13 162 career rushing yards henry is 5 193 away from tying the all time career record of 18 355 yards held by pro football hall of famer emmitt smith it s a lofty goal but one smith believes henry can achieve oh yeah i think it s possible smith said via espn derrick henry is a bigger back he takes great care of his body he s in great shape henry indeed owns a size advantage over smith who was listed at 5 foot 9 221 pounds and reached his rushing record in 226 games at 6 foot 3 and 252 pounds henry currently stands at 154 games while difficult to project another three or four seasons doesn t seem outrageous for henry who remains an elite back and a frightening force just ask the colts defense how week 1 went for them when henry steamrolled through indianapolis in the same fashion he s displayed since he was a youngster in tennessee better yet ask his defensive teammate cornerback marlon humphrey as derrick keeps getting older you start thinking he can t do this forever humphrey said via espn then he does that and it s like maybe he can henry has long existed as a unique specimen an athletic freak of nature whose size power and speed has propelled him to great feats if anyone can match or break smith s record it s henry but it s also not right around the corner for now he has the vote of confidence of the record holder and a dynamic explosive surrounding cast capable of helping him march closer

material_news_signals.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 2: Caleb Williams, Lamar Jackson and Trevor Lawrence soar into top five
material_news_signals.description: Movement abounds in Nick Shook's QB Index, with prolific passers like Trevor Lawrence flying up the rankings as scattershot signal-callers like Drake Maye plummet. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: i begin this qb index with a disclaimer with only one week s worth of evidence there is more volatility than usual reputation matters but so do recent results we re a long way from solidifying the standing of many of these quarterbacks and because we saw some unexpected outcomes in week 1 prepare yourself for some aggressive swings it ll even out eventually for now i have one bit of advice buckle up note up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 1 qb index tier 1 josh allen nearly blew buffalo s chances of scoring a huge week 1 win with an inexplicable yolo ball into the end zone late in the fourth quarter but houston cb kamari lassiter dropped the potential game sealing pick now that i ve put that on the record allow me to acknowledge that allen was otherwise marvelous in this contest he played all the allen hits in the bills 36 31 win he scored a rushing touchdown on a wild scramble connected with dj moore on a 43 yard touchdown pass scored another rushing touchdown from a yard out and directed a 96 yard touchdown drive with the game on the line capping it by firing a rocket between two defenders to josh palmer for the game winning score that s a great start to his annual mvp push next gen stats insight via nfl pro allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest mark in a game since week 18 of 2022 and he was efficient pushing the ball downfield completing 11 of 16 attempts of 10 plus air yards for 286 yards and two touchdowns caleb williams remains one of the most thrilling joyous watches in the nfl he makes throws nobody else is capable of completing on a weekly basis and did so at least twice on sunday dropping a laser guided strike over two defenders to cole kmet for a touchdown and heaving an off platform missile to rome odunze to set up another score in the first game of williams third professional season i arrived at a new realization the 24 year old now deeply understands the timing and priorities of ben johnson s scheme and operates comfortably within its structure but much like a great guitarist caleb s artistic improvisation is what makes him special and elevates chicago s offense from very good to fantastic sunday s game included a collection of such examples producing thrills on the ground and through the air that have become part of williams brand next gen stats insight via nfl pro williams reached a top speed of 20 8 mph on his second touchdown run a 29 yard scamper in the final minute of the second quarter of chicago s 59 37 win over carolina lamar jackson raved about declan doyle s offense as a breath of fresh air entering the new season perhaps he should have described it as a hurricane because baltimore destroyed indianapolis on sunday jackson played an integral part throwing for 324 yards by leaning heavily on zay flowers early and distributing the ball fairly evenly after the star wideout left with a hamstring tweak it helped that everything worked for the offense but i won t let derrick henry s 144 yards take away from jackson s performance if this becomes the standard for the ravens expect jackson to own a firm place in the mvp discussion again things looked too easy for trevor lawrence and the jaguars who shredded cleveland s defense all afternoon in jacksonville parker washington jakobi meyers and even brenton strange all renewed their connection with lawrence who picked up right where he left off at the end of the 2025 season tier 2 this ranking isn t entirely based on one week s showing and this is where reputation mixes with results matthew stafford wasn t himself in the rams season opening loss to the 49ers in australia but the reigning nfl mvp wasn t all that awful surprisingly stafford finished with a completion percentage over expected cpoe of 2 5 bryce young played excellently on the other hand and leapfrogs stafford for perhaps the only time all season in fact let s take a second to dive a little deeper into young s performance a typically up and down quarterback young looked confident in his most aggressive game since he threw for 448 yards in carolina s week 11 win over atlanta last season most importantly young finally looked fully comfortable in dave canales offense made decisions with conviction and truly elevated carolina s offense was it enough to keep up with caleb williams bears no but it s worth tracking over the next month because it could heavily influence his contract talks with the panthers if this is a preview of what s to come next gen stats insight via nfl pro young threw for 289 yards and averaged 14 5 yards per attempt against zone coverage compared to 72 yards and 4 2 yards per attempt against man coverage in sunday s loss to chicago now back to the rest of the group patrick mahomes scored a rushing touchdown but it s clear he s not quite back to his old self in the mobility department which didn t help his passing efforts early in monday night s 31 10 win over denver that s fine when kenneth walker is shredding an opposing defense but kansas city can t count on that every week mahomes eventually found a rhythm in the second half and finished the game with a pair of td passes but i didn t expect him to start lighting up defenses through the air instantly this will probably be a slow burn dak prescott joe burrow and jared goff largely looked like themselves but at lower than usual outputs with prescott adding an uncharacteristic interception as a result of a failed throwaway attempt that led to a giants touchdown every quarterback is shaking off some rust in week 1 so there s no cause for alarm brock purdy was incredibly sharp in australia and confidently cooked the rams defense even after losing de zhaun stribling to injury the uncs of the world enjoyed watching him connect with three different thirtysomething receivers for touchdowns and i m sure purdy was happy to have mike evans on his side to start the season next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy tied his career high with seven straight dropbacks when aligned under center no play action in week 1 against the rams completing all seven passes for 76 yards and two touchdowns including a 39 yard strike to demarcus robinson in the second quarter jalen hurts had a classic jalen hurts game in week 1 connecting on a handful of downfield shots while willing philadelphia s offense down the field with well timed scrambles against washington the eagles still need to be more consistent offensively on a per play basis but for one week hurts was able to carry them out of the muck to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 6 of 9 downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage on those throws was the eighth highest downfield total of his career while he threw three plus downfield touchdown passes for just the sixth time tier 3 remember how i said there would be some stunning volatility in the rankings this week well we ve reached that portion of the program i couldn t stomach dropping justin herbert any further because he still threw for 200 yards but that interception in the fourth quarter was ghastly and an unnecessary risk which we usually don t see from herbert especially when trying to climb out of a nine point hole tyler shough on the other hand shook off his early mistakes and let it rip in the second half throwing the saints back into a game that seemed destined to end in a lopsided loss i m not afraid to admit how much i m enjoying watching him progress as a starter he s fearless when the pressure is on and is developing a clutch gene that should entertain saints fans throughout 2026 it would be nice if their offense woke up earlier next time though next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 8 of 11 passes against the lions blitz for 79 yards and three touchdowns in the second half and overtime after going just 2 of 7 for 17 yards with an interception and a sack fumble in the first half on downfield passes 10 air yards shough completed 11 of 16 attempts for 261 yards and a touchdown the most such yards by a saints quarterback since drew brees in week 6 2016 c j stroud played really well for most of sunday s close loss to the bills but bookending a good game with lost fumbles will knock you down the qb index jordan love lands in the same category after singlehandedly carrying the packers offense through three quarters then crumbling beneath the pressure applied by brian flores defense it wasn t his fault alone green bay s offensive line struggled significantly with picking up blitzes and stunts but as the director of the offense love needed to be better to stop the meltdown we only saw a handful of plays from sam darnold glute injury who lands ahead of jacoby brissett largely because he wasn t afforded much time to succeed or fail brissett certainly didn t fail powering a hungry cardinals offense by leaning on trey mcbride and even finding marvin harrison for a long completion on arizona s way to stunning the chargers next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett completed 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards in the cards upset win over the bolts drake maye s decent start completely fell apart in the fourth quarter and two of his three interceptions were solely his fault in terms of starts following an mvp runner up campaign this one will not be remembered fondly next gen stats insight via nfl pro all three of maye s interceptions came on deep attempts 20 plus air yards two more than he threw all last season one maye s interception on new england s final drive lost the patriots 47 9 win probability the most on a single pass attempt of his career geno smith did a lot to prove the raiders nightmarish situation was to blame for his ugly 2025 season benefitting from a strong offensive line in a very professional week 1 outing and kindling a new connection with adonai mitchell that deserves the eyes emoji jaxson dart delivered a similar performance and introduced the world to his new favorite target former ravens tight end and new new york star isaiah likely i m fascinated to see if the giants can sustain this level of success against better defenses than the cowboys revamped unit tier 4 when you sign up for a season with baker mayfield you know you ll have days in which his competitive streak and refusal to surrender will lead to multiple turnovers it happened twice on sunday with the first resulting in a defensive touchdown for the bengals and the second probably costing the buccaneers seven points baker giveth and taketh away but it s probably best it happened in week 1 not week 18 next gen stats insight via nfl pro mayfield averaged 4 7 air yards per attempt fourth fewest in a game in his career and 2 0 air yards per completion third fewest in the 33 27 loss to the bengals he completed 18 of 19 passes under 10 air yards for 134 yards and 5 of 8 passes over 10 air yards for 82 yards jayden daniels produced a mixed bag in philadelphia but the third year pro moved around confidently and delivered in key spots keeping washington in a tight contest that included a nice touchdown pass to stefon diggs and saw daniels lead the commanders on a 12 play 63 yard touchdown drive in crunch time most importantly he exited a pressure packed afternoon healthy next gen stats insight via nfl pro daniels was pressured on 19 of 38 dropbacks in week 1 against the eagles translating to a 50 0 pressure rate that tied his career high week 9 of 2025 vs seattle he went 15 for 19 with 138 yards and a touchdown when throwing from a clean pocket 78 9 completion percentage but just 3 for 15 with 26 yards and a touchdown when under pressure 20 0 aaron rodgers delivered one vintage moment when he rolled left set his feet and fired a bullet to pat freiermuth in the back of the end zone otherwise much of sunday saw rodgers try to force a connection with dk metcalf take many more deep shots than he did last season and finish with a passable at best performance at least he looked more like himself in mike mccarthy s offense next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers 9 2 air yards per target in sunday s 20 13 win over the falcons is the highest figure he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw mark representing his third highest average in a game with the franchise bo nix produced one truly impressive scoring drive and capped it with a pretty touchdown pass to evan engram to tie monday night s game at 7 7 that was it for the highlights the rest of the night included plenty of lowlights with nix appearing overwhelmed and out of sync amid a hailstorm of pressures generated by steve spagnuolo s defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropbacks against the chiefs his second highest pressure rate in a game in his career nix finished 2 of 10 for 5 yards and an interception under pressure with two strip sacks compared to 15 of 18 for 126 yards and a touchdown from a clean pocket kirk cousins played fine football against the lowly dolphins took what miami s defense gave him kept drives moving and finished three with touchdown tosses which meets the standard of expectation for him it also helped that raiders rb ashton jeanty became the dolphins most important problem cousins age showed in his performance though with the 38 year old throwing a couple of ugly interceptions and one dirt ball that saddened me because of how the man fell without getting touched as he threw it i think the wait for no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza won t last all that long daniel jones didn t move as much as usual in his first game back from a season ending achilles injury but it was difficult to put too much stock in his performance given how quickly the ravens buried the colts in a three score deficit he showed some rust in his decision making too forcing a pass into a window that didn t exist with roquan smith lurking underneath in coverage resulting in an interception malik willis did some nice things but was up and down at best and is clearly still acclimating to life as a full time starter his mobility is a weapon and helped him score a rushing touchdown he threw a handful of pretty passes and never looked especially overwhelmed he also threw a groaner of an interception and wasn t able to elevate the dolphins offense as they ll need him to in order to compete this season as far as debuts go it was passable given the surrounding circumstances but there s plenty of room to improve tier 5 kyler murray s debut in minnesota didn t last long included an interception on his first pass attempt a desperation heave fired under instant pressure and ended when he slid at the end of a short scramble was hit late drawing a flag and suffered a concussion leaving me with almost nothing to evaluate in the few snaps he saw prior to exiting there wasn t much to like cam ward s first game in brian daboll s offense was not the dream many fans hoped for the absence of a running game and ineffective pass protection limited ward who didn t handle the challenges well this process will take some time and will definitely include growing pains there were plenty in sunday s 23 10 loss to the jets next gen stats insight via nfl pro ward faced pressure on 42 1 of dropbacks the second highest rate of his career 50 in week 1 of 2025 vs denver under pressure ward completed 3 of 10 passes for 17 yards compared to 16 of 22 for 123 yards and a touchdown without pressure cooper rush was only effective on passes behind the line of scrimmage eliminating the downfield threat from atlanta s offense one target zero catches for kyle pitts and funneling the entire falcons attack through bijan robinson that understandably only worked early and once the steelers adjusted rush had nowhere else to turn succumbing to the pressure applied by pittsburgh s defense in an ugly low scoring loss he also didn t face a single man coverage snap somewhat of a slap in the face from the steelers defense which didn t fear rush enough to try to blanket falcons pass catchers in one on one matchups next gen stats insight via nfl pro rush did not complete a pass when pressured and particularly struggled when holding on to the ball for longer than 2 5 seconds completing 6 of 14 attempts for 83 yards while throwing two interceptions deshaun watson s numbers lied to you he looked just as slow to make decisions as he did in the preseason was consistently inaccurate especially when unsettled by the pass rush threw an awful interception on his third attempt of the season ran himself into pressures with remarkably deep pass drops and generally played like a quarterback who hadn t seen regular season action in two years todd monken told reporters he found plenty to like in watson s tape but the only example i can support was his downfield shot to rookie denzel boston for a touchdown in garbage time i think week 2 might be his last shot to prove he s still worth rostering that is unless monken stubbornly keeps rolling with him

material_news_signals.headline: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back soreness, expects to play Week 2 vs. Texans
material_news_signals.description: Bengals QB Joe Burrow told reporters Wednesday he's dealing with back tightness following Cincinnati's Week 1 win over Tampa Bay, but he expects to play Sunday versus the Houston Texans.
material_news_signals.body_text: joe burrow didn t exit week 1 completely unscathed the bengals quarterback told reporters on wednesday he s dealing with back tightness following cincinnati s week 1 win over tampa bay but he expects to play sunday versus the houston texans burrow officially was listed as limited on wednesday s practice report burrow appeared to be fine in sunday s season opening win completing 25 of 35 passes for 254 yards and a touchdown while also throwing a pick six he couldn t identify when exactly he hurt his back during the game telling reporters that he didn t start feeling discomfort until after the win and didn t seem too concerned about the issue adding i ll be all right burrow s injury history is a sensitive subject in cincinnati the franchise quarterback has missed significant time in three of his six nfl seasons was forced out for most of last season due to a toe injury suffered in week 2 and is understandably the most valuable player in the bengals organization making his availability paramount to cincinnati s chances of success while many quarterbacks carry lofty statistical goals into each season burrow s includes another essential task stay healthy wednesday s development shouldn t incite panic but for a player with burrow s injury history it s mildly unsettling in the middle of september

material_news_signals.description: Movement abounds in Nick Shook's QB Index, with prolific passers like Trevor Lawrence flying up the rankings as scattershot signal-callers like Drake Maye plummet. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: i begin this qb index with a disclaimer with only one week s worth of evidence there is more volatility than usual reputation matters but so do recent results we re a long way from solidifying the standing of many of these quarterbacks and because we saw some unexpected outcomes in week 1 prepare yourself for some aggressive swings it ll even out eventually for now i have one bit of advice buckle up note up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 1 qb index tier 1 josh allen nearly blew buffalo s chances of scoring a huge week 1 win with an inexplicable yolo ball into the end zone late in the fourth quarter but houston cb kamari lassiter dropped the potential game sealing pick now that i ve put that on the record allow me to acknowledge that allen was otherwise marvelous in this contest he played all the allen hits in the bills 36 31 win he scored a rushing touchdown on a wild scramble connected with dj moore on a 43 yard touchdown pass scored another rushing touchdown from a yard out and directed a 96 yard touchdown drive with the game on the line capping it by firing a rocket between two defenders to josh palmer for the game winning score that s a great start to his annual mvp push next gen stats insight via nfl pro allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest mark in a game since week 18 of 2022 and he was efficient pushing the ball downfield completing 11 of 16 attempts of 10 plus air yards for 286 yards and two touchdowns caleb williams remains one of the most thrilling joyous watches in the nfl he makes throws nobody else is capable of completing on a weekly basis and did so at least twice on sunday dropping a laser guided strike over two defenders to cole kmet for a touchdown and heaving an off platform missile to rome odunze to set up another score in the first game of williams third professional season i arrived at a new realization the 24 year old now deeply understands the timing and priorities of ben johnson s scheme and operates comfortably within its structure but much like a great guitarist caleb s artistic improvisation is what makes him special and elevates chicago s offense from very good to fantastic sunday s game included a collection of such examples producing thrills on the ground and through the air that have become part of williams brand next gen stats insight via nfl pro williams reached a top speed of 20 8 mph on his second touchdown run a 29 yard scamper in the final minute of the second quarter of chicago s 59 37 win over carolina lamar jackson raved about declan doyle s offense as a breath of fresh air entering the new season perhaps he should have described it as a hurricane because baltimore destroyed indianapolis on sunday jackson played an integral part throwing for 324 yards by leaning heavily on zay flowers early and distributing the ball fairly evenly after the star wideout left with a hamstring tweak it helped that everything worked for the offense but i won t let derrick henry s 144 yards take away from jackson s performance if this becomes the standard for the ravens expect jackson to own a firm place in the mvp discussion again things looked too easy for trevor lawrence and the jaguars who shredded cleveland s defense all afternoon in jacksonville parker washington jakobi meyers and even brenton strange all renewed their connection with lawrence who picked up right where he left off at the end of the 2025 season tier 2 this ranking isn t entirely based on one week s showing and this is where reputation mixes with results matthew stafford wasn t himself in the rams season opening loss to the 49ers in australia but the reigning nfl mvp wasn t all that awful surprisingly stafford finished with a completion percentage over expected cpoe of 2 5 bryce young played excellently on the other hand and leapfrogs stafford for perhaps the only time all season in fact let s take a second to dive a little deeper into young s performance a typically up and down quarterback young looked confident in his most aggressive game since he threw for 448 yards in carolina s week 11 win over atlanta last season most importantly young finally looked fully comfortable in dave canales offense made decisions with conviction and truly elevated carolina s offense was it enough to keep up with caleb williams bears no but it s worth tracking over the next month because it could heavily influence his contract talks with the panthers if this is a preview of what s to come next gen stats insight via nfl pro young threw for 289 yards and averaged 14 5 yards per attempt against zone coverage compared to 72 yards and 4 2 yards per attempt against man coverage in sunday s loss to chicago now back to the rest of the group patrick mahomes scored a rushing touchdown but it s clear he s not quite back to his old self in the mobility department which didn t help his passing efforts early in monday night s 31 10 win over denver that s fine when kenneth walker is shredding an opposing defense but kansas city can t count on that every week mahomes eventually found a rhythm in the second half and finished the game with a pair of td passes but i didn t expect him to start lighting up defenses through the air instantly this will probably be a slow burn dak prescott joe burrow and jared goff largely looked like themselves but at lower than usual outputs with prescott adding an uncharacteristic interception as a result of a failed throwaway attempt that led to a giants touchdown every quarterback is shaking off some rust in week 1 so there s no cause for alarm brock purdy was incredibly sharp in australia and confidently cooked the rams defense even after losing de zhaun stribling to injury the uncs of the world enjoyed watching him connect with three different thirtysomething receivers for touchdowns and i m sure purdy was happy to have mike evans on his side to start the season next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy tied his career high with seven straight dropbacks when aligned under center no play action in week 1 against the rams completing all seven passes for 76 yards and two touchdowns including a 39 yard strike to demarcus robinson in the second quarter jalen hurts had a classic jalen hurts game in week 1 connecting on a handful of downfield shots while willing philadelphia s offense down the field with well timed scrambles against washington the eagles still need to be more consistent offensively on a per play basis but for one week hurts was able to carry them out of the muck to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 6 of 9 downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage on those throws was the eighth highest downfield total of his career while he threw three plus downfield touchdown passes for just the sixth time tier 3 remember how i said there would be some stunning volatility in the rankings this week well we ve reached that portion of the program i couldn t stomach dropping justin herbert any further because he still threw for 200 yards but that interception in the fourth quarter was ghastly and an unnecessary risk which we usually don t see from herbert especially when trying to climb out of a nine point hole tyler shough on the other hand shook off his early mistakes and let it rip in the second half throwing the saints back into a game that seemed destined to end in a lopsided loss i m not afraid to admit how much i m enjoying watching him progress as a starter he s fearless when the pressure is on and is developing a clutch gene that should entertain saints fans throughout 2026 it would be nice if their offense woke up earlier next time though next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 8 of 11 passes against the lions blitz for 79 yards and three touchdowns in the second half and overtime after going just 2 of 7 for 17 yards with an interception and a sack fumble in the first half on downfield passes 10 air yards shough completed 11 of 16 attempts for 261 yards and a touchdown the most such yards by a saints quarterback since drew brees in week 6 2016 c j stroud played really well for most of sunday s close loss to the bills but bookending a good game with lost fumbles will knock you down the qb index jordan love lands in the same category after singlehandedly carrying the packers offense through three quarters then crumbling beneath the pressure applied by brian flores defense it wasn t his fault alone green bay s offensive line struggled significantly with picking up blitzes and stunts but as the director of the offense love needed to be better to stop the meltdown we only saw a handful of plays from sam darnold glute injury who lands ahead of jacoby brissett largely because he wasn t afforded much time to succeed or fail brissett certainly didn t fail powering a hungry cardinals offense by leaning on trey mcbride and even finding marvin harrison for a long completion on arizona s way to stunning the chargers next gen stats insight via nfl pro brissett completed 6 of 9 passes for 113 yards 23 9 cpoe on throws over 10 air yards in the cards upset win over the bolts drake maye s decent start completely fell apart in the fourth quarter and two of his three interceptions were solely his fault in terms of starts following an mvp runner up campaign this one will not be remembered fondly next gen stats insight via nfl pro all three of maye s interceptions came on deep attempts 20 plus air yards two more than he threw all last season one maye s interception on new england s final drive lost the patriots 47 9 win probability the most on a single pass attempt of his career geno smith did a lot to prove the raiders nightmarish situation was to blame for his ugly 2025 season benefitting from a strong offensive line in a very professional week 1 outing and kindling a new connection with adonai mitchell that deserves the eyes emoji jaxson dart delivered a similar performance and introduced the world to his new favorite target former ravens tight end and new new york star isaiah likely i m fascinated to see if the giants can sustain this level of success against better defenses than the cowboys revamped unit tier 4 when you sign up for a season with baker mayfield you know you ll have days in which his competitive streak and refusal to surrender will lead to multiple turnovers it happened twice on sunday with the first resulting in a defensive touchdown for the bengals and the second probably costing the buccaneers seven points baker giveth and taketh away but it s probably best it happened in week 1 not week 18 next gen stats insight via nfl pro mayfield averaged 4 7 air yards per attempt fourth fewest in a game in his career and 2 0 air yards per completion third fewest in the 33 27 loss to the bengals he completed 18 of 19 passes under 10 air yards for 134 yards and 5 of 8 passes over 10 air yards for 82 yards jayden daniels produced a mixed bag in philadelphia but the third year pro moved around confidently and delivered in key spots keeping washington in a tight contest that included a nice touchdown pass to stefon diggs and saw daniels lead the commanders on a 12 play 63 yard touchdown drive in crunch time most importantly he exited a pressure packed afternoon healthy next gen stats insight via nfl pro daniels was pressured on 19 of 38 dropbacks in week 1 against the eagles translating to a 50 0 pressure rate that tied his career high week 9 of 2025 vs seattle he went 15 for 19 with 138 yards and a touchdown when throwing from a clean pocket 78 9 completion percentage but just 3 for 15 with 26 yards and a touchdown when under pressure 20 0 aaron rodgers delivered one vintage moment when he rolled left set his feet and fired a bullet to pat freiermuth in the back of the end zone otherwise much of sunday saw rodgers try to force a connection with dk metcalf take many more deep shots than he did last season and finish with a passable at best performance at least he looked more like himself in mike mccarthy s offense next gen stats insight via nfl pro rodgers 9 2 air yards per target in sunday s 20 13 win over the falcons is the highest figure he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw mark representing his third highest average in a game with the franchise bo nix produced one truly impressive scoring drive and capped it with a pretty touchdown pass to evan engram to tie monday night s game at 7 7 that was it for the highlights the rest of the night included plenty of lowlights with nix appearing overwhelmed and out of sync amid a hailstorm of pressures generated by steve spagnuolo s defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropbacks against the chiefs his second highest pressure rate in a game in his career nix finished 2 of 10 for 5 yards and an interception under pressure with two strip sacks compared to 15 of 18 for 126 yards and a touchdown from a clean pocket kirk cousins played fine football against the lowly dolphins took what miami s defense gave him kept drives moving and finished three with touchdown tosses which meets the standard of expectation for him it also helped that raiders rb ashton jeanty became the dolphins most important problem cousins age showed in his performance though with the 38 year old throwing a couple of ugly interceptions and one dirt ball that saddened me because of how the man fell without getting touched as he threw it i think the wait for no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza won t last all that long daniel jones didn t move as much as usual in his first game back from a season ending achilles injury but it was difficult to put too much stock in his performance given how quickly the ravens buried the colts in a three score deficit he showed some rust in his decision making too forcing a pass into a window that didn t exist with roquan smith lurking underneath in coverage resulting in an interception malik willis did some nice things but was up and down at best and is clearly still acclimating to life as a full time starter his mobility is a weapon and helped him score a rushing touchdown he threw a handful of pretty passes and never looked especially overwhelmed he also threw a groaner of an interception and wasn t able to elevate the dolphins offense as they ll need him to in order to compete this season as far as debuts go it was passable given the surrounding circumstances but there s plenty of room to improve tier 5 kyler murray s debut in minnesota didn t last long included an interception on his first pass attempt a desperation heave fired under instant pressure and ended when he slid at the end of a short scramble was hit late drawing a flag and suffered a concussion leaving me with almost nothing to evaluate in the few snaps he saw prior to exiting there wasn t much to like cam ward s first game in brian daboll s offense was not the dream many fans hoped for the absence of a running game and ineffective pass protection limited ward who didn t handle the challenges well this process will take some time and will definitely include growing pains there were plenty in sunday s 23 10 loss to the jets next gen stats insight via nfl pro ward faced pressure on 42 1 of dropbacks the second highest rate of his career 50 in week 1 of 2025 vs denver under pressure ward completed 3 of 10 passes for 17 yards compared to 16 of 22 for 123 yards and a touchdown without pressure cooper rush was only effective on passes behind the line of scrimmage eliminating the downfield threat from atlanta s offense one target zero catches for kyle pitts and funneling the entire falcons attack through bijan robinson that understandably only worked early and once the steelers adjusted rush had nowhere else to turn succumbing to the pressure material_news_signals.headline: Caleb Williams, Bears prepare for 'mental war' against DC Brian Flores, Vikings
material_news_signals.description: Fresh off a fantastic season debut and a 59-point explosion, the Bears return home to host the Vikings. The challenge ahead includes countering one of the NFL's most aggressive and exotic defenses.
material_news_signals.body_text: fresh off a fantastic season debut and a 59 point explosion the chicago bears return home to host the minnesota vikings the challenge ahead includes countering one of the nfl s most aggressive and exotic defenses directed by coordinator brian flores in simple terms it s an unstoppable force meeting an immovable object from bears coach ben johnson s perspective it s more of a war of attrition with the opposition targeting a key resource emotion coach ben johnson calls this mental war when you go against versus him and that s what it is bears quarterback caleb williams said wednesday via espn you ve got to be able to go out there and bad things are going to happen you ve got to be able to fight back and stay steady that s one of the biggest things is not allowing his defense and all of that to fluster you and get in your mind you stay steady and now it s time to go make plays and get completions and when the big ones show up take them and find them williams certainly took plenty of the big plays in week 1 chicago piled up 552 yards of offense williams completed 21 of 29 passes for 269 yards and two touchdowns and added two more rushing scores of his own including a dazzling 29 yard sprint to the end zone just before halftime for one week everything worked chicago knows the going won t be that easy against minnesota the vikings delivered their own avalanche of sorts on sunday but on the defensive side of the ball sending a flurry of blitzes at packers quarterback jordan love that powered a 22 point fourth quarter and a 17 point win in a game that had previously appeared destined to end in defeat in one half flores defense reminded the rest of the nfl of its strengths the two clash sunday in a contest that will test the bears preparation and ability to adjust quickly you don t johnson said with a laugh when asked wednesday how he can predict how flores might approach the game you try to have answers for everything he s been in this division three years now and yeah i mean you d like to think he s put everything he could possibly do on tape until you play him next and you realize he hasn t yet so it ll be something new there always is with him and that s what makes him such a good coordinator it s a great challenge it really is you have a lot of fun on game day now the week of preparation is not so much fun but you know there s a lot of back and forth that goes into it with only one week complete there s plenty left to discover in this new nfl season johnson hasn t been shy about his record breaking goals for his offense in 2026 and after one week it seems the bears are on track to accomplish them scoring every drive is our mindset williams said that s the potential of us that s an internal expectation that s an internal feeling just of what we have up front out wide and in the backfield it s an expectation from ourselves to be able to go out there and score every time and figure out ways to help the defense that s our part to help this team help special teams is scoring points as many as we can on as many drives that we have that s our challenge we ll learn whether that s still realistic after these two heavyweights collide sunday

material_news_signals.headline: NFL QB rankings, Week 2: Caleb Williams, Lamar Jackson and Trevor Lawrence soar into top five
material_news_signals.description: Movement abounds in Nick Shook's QB Index, with prolific passers like Trevor Lawrence flying up the rankings as scattershot signal-callers like Drake Maye plummet. Check out the updated pecking order, 1-32, heading into Week 2 of the 2026 NFL season.
material_news_signals.body_text: i begin this qb index with a disclaimer with only one week s worth of evidence there is more volatility than usual reputation matters but so do recent results we re a long way from solidifying the standing of many of these quarterbacks and because we saw some unexpected outcomes in week 1 prepare yourself for some aggressive swings it ll even out eventually for now i have one bit of advice buckle up note up down arrows illustrate movement from the week 1 qb index tier 1 josh allen nearly blew buffalo s chances of scoring a huge week 1 win with an inexplicable yolo ball into the end zone late in the fourth quarter but houston cb kamari lassiter dropped the potential game sealing pick now that i ve put that on the record allow me to acknowledge that allen was otherwise marvelous in this contest he played all the allen hits in the bills 36 31 win he scored a rushing touchdown on a wild scramble connected with dj moore on a 43 yard touchdown pass scored another rushing touchdown from a yard out and directed a 96 yard touchdown drive with the game on the line capping it by firing a rocket between two defenders to josh palmer for the game winning score that s a great start to his annual mvp push next gen stats insight via nfl pro allen averaged 12 6 air yards per attempt his highest mark in a game since week 18 of 2022 and he was efficient pushing the ball downfield completing 11 of 16 attempts of 10 plus air yards for 286 yards and two touchdowns caleb williams remains one of the most thrilling joyous watches in the nfl he makes throws nobody else is capable of completing on a weekly basis and did so at least twice on sunday dropping a laser guided strike over two defenders to cole kmet for a touchdown and heaving an off platform missile to rome odunze to set up another score in the first game of williams third professional season i arrived at a new realization the 24 year old now deeply understands the timing and priorities of ben johnson s scheme and operates comfortably within its structure but much like a great guitarist caleb s artistic improvisation is what makes him special and elevates chicago s offense from very good to fantastic sunday s game included a collection of such examples producing thrills on the ground and through the air that have become part of williams brand next gen stats insight via nfl pro williams reached a top speed of 20 8 mph on his second touchdown run a 29 yard scamper in the final minute of the second quarter of chicago s 59 37 win over carolina lamar jackson raved about declan doyle s offense as a breath of fresh air entering the new season perhaps he should have described it as a hurricane because baltimore destroyed indianapolis on sunday jackson played an integral part throwing for 324 yards by leaning heavily on zay flowers early and distributing the ball fairly evenly after the star wideout left with a hamstring tweak it helped that everything worked for the offense but i won t let derrick henry s 144 yards take away from jackson s performance if this becomes the standard for the ravens expect jackson to own a firm place in the mvp discussion again things looked too easy for trevor lawrence and the jaguars who shredded cleveland s defense all afternoon in jacksonville parker washington jakobi meyers and even brenton strange all renewed their connection with lawrence who picked up right where he left off at the end of the 2025 season tier 2 this ranking isn t entirely based on one week s showing and this is where reputation mixes with results matthew stafford wasn t himself in the rams season opening loss to the 49ers in australia but the reigning nfl mvp wasn t all that awful surprisingly stafford finished with a completion percentage over expected cpoe of 2 5 bryce young played excellently on the other hand and leapfrogs stafford for perhaps the only time all season in fact let s take a second to dive a little deeper into young s performance a typically up and down quarterback young looked confident in his most aggressive game since he threw for 448 yards in carolina s week 11 win over atlanta last season most importantly young finally looked fully comfortable in dave canales offense made decisions with conviction and truly elevated carolina s offense was it enough to keep up with caleb williams bears no but it s worth tracking over the next month because it could heavily influence his contract talks with the panthers if this is a preview of what s to come next gen stats insight via nfl pro young threw for 289 yards and averaged 14 5 yards per attempt against zone coverage compared to 72 yards and 4 2 yards per attempt against man coverage in sunday s loss to chicago now back to the rest of the group patrick mahomes scored a rushing touchdown but it s clear he s not quite back to his old self in the mobility department which didn t help his passing efforts early in monday night s 31 10 win over denver that s fine when kenneth walker is shredding an opposing defense but kansas city can t count on that every week mahomes eventually found a rhythm in the second half and finished the game with a pair of td passes but i didn t expect him to start lighting up defenses through the air instantly this will probably be a slow burn dak prescott joe burrow and jared goff largely looked like themselves but at lower than usual outputs with prescott adding an uncharacteristic interception as a result of a failed throwaway attempt that led to a giants touchdown every quarterback is shaking off some rust in week 1 so there s no cause for alarm brock purdy was incredibly sharp in australia and confidently cooked the rams defense even after losing de zhaun stribling to injury the uncs of the world enjoyed watching him connect with three different thirtysomething receivers for touchdowns and i m sure purdy was happy to have mike evans on his side to start the season next gen stats insight via nfl pro purdy tied his career high with seven straight dropbacks when aligned under center no play action in week 1 against the rams completing all seven passes for 76 yards and two touchdowns including a 39 yard strike to demarcus robinson in the second quarter jalen hurts had a classic jalen hurts game in week 1 connecting on a handful of downfield shots while willing philadelphia s offense down the field with well timed scrambles against washington the eagles still need to be more consistent offensively on a per play basis but for one week hurts was able to carry them out of the muck to victory next gen stats insight via nfl pro hurts completed 6 of 9 downfield passes 10 air yards for 176 yards and three touchdowns in week 1 against the commanders his yardage on those throws was the eighth highest downfield total of his career while he threw three plus downfield touchdown passes for just the sixth time tier 3 remember how i said there would be some stunning volatility in the rankings this week well we ve reached that portion of the program i couldn t stomach dropping justin herbert any further because he still threw for 200 yards but that interception in the fourth quarter was ghastly and an unnecessary risk which we usually don t see from herbert especially when trying to climb out of a nine point hole tyler shough on the other hand shook off his early mistakes and let it rip in the second half throwing the saints back into a game that seemed destined to end in a lopsided loss i m not afraid to admit how much i m enjoying watching him progress as a starter he s fearless when the pressure is on and is developing a clutch gene that should entertain saints fans throughout 2026 it would be nice if their offense woke up earlier next time though next gen stats insight via nfl pro shough completed 8 of 11 passes against the lions blitz for 79 yards and three touchdowns in the second half and overtime after going just 2 of 7 for 17 yards with an interception and a sack fumble in the first half on downfield passes 10 air yards shough completed 11 of 16 attempts for 261 yards and a touchdown the most such yards by a saints quarterback since drew brees in week 6 2016 c j stroud played really well for most of sunday s close loss to the bills but bookending a good game with lost fumbles will knock you down the qb index jordan love lands in the same category after singlehandedly carrying the packers offense through three quarters then crumbling beneath the pressure applied by brian flores defense it wasn t his fault alone green bay s offensive line struggled significantly with picking up blitzes and stunts but as the director of the offense love needed to be better to stop the meltdown we only saw a handful of plays from sam darnold glute injury who lands ahead of jacoby brissett largely because he wasn t afforded much time to succeed or fail brissett certainly didn t fail powering a hungry cardinals offense by leaning on trey mcbride that deserves the eyes emoji jaxson dart delivered a similar performance and introduced the world to his new favorite target former ravens tight end and new new york star isaiah likely i m fascinated to see if the giants can sustain this level of success against better defenses than the cowboys revamped unit tier 4 when you sign up for a season with baker mayfield you know you ll have days in probably costing the buccaneers seven points baker giveth and taketh away but it s probably best it happened in week 1 not week 18 next gen stats insight via nfl pro mayfield averaged 4 7 air yards stats insight via nfl pro rodgers 9 2 air yards per target in sunday s 20 13 win over the falcons is the highest figure he has recorded as a member of the steelers with his 2 95 second time to throw night s game at 7 7 that was it for the highlights the rest of the night included plenty of lowlights with nix appearing overwhelmed and out of sync amid a hailstorm of pressures generated by steve spagnuolo s defense next gen stats insight via nfl pro nix was pressured on 45 5 of his dropbacks against the chiefs his second highest pressure rate in a game in his career nix finished 2 of 10 for 5 dolphins most important problem cousins age showed in his performance though with the 38 year old throwing a couple of ugly interceptions and one dirt ball that saddened me because of how the man fell without getting touched as he threw it i think the wait for no 1 overall pick fernando mendoza won t last all that long daniel jones didn t move as much as usual in his first game back from a season ending achilles injury but it was difficult to put too much stock in his performance given how quickly the ravens buried the colts in a three score deficit he showed some rust in his decision making too forcing a pass into a window that didn t exist with roquan smith lurking underneath in coverage resulting in an interception malik willis did some nice things but was up and down at best and is clearly still acclimating to life as a full time starter his mobility is a weapon and helped him score a rushing touchdown he threw a handful of pretty passes and never looked especially overwhelmed he also threw a groaner of an interception and wasn t able to elevate the dolphins offense as they ll need him to in order to compete this season as far as debuts go it was passable given the material_news_signals.headline: NFL ties Week 1 scoring record for Super Bowl era
material_news_signals.description: Thanks to the Kansas City Chiefs and Denver Broncos reaching 41 combined points on Monday night, the opening slate of games for the 2026 season tied a record for the most Week 1 points scored during the Super Bowl era.
material_news_signals.body_text: a 14 year week 1 record has been matched thanks to the kansas city chiefs and denver broncos combining for 41 points on monday night the opening slate of games for the 2026 season has officially tied the 2012 season s record for the most week 1 points scored 791 during the super bowl era entering monday s afc west showdown teams had averaged 50 0 combined points per game per nfl research with the week 1 finale bringing the average down to 49 4 tying such a mark would ve been hard to see coming on wednesday when the seattle seahawks and new england patriots kicked off the campaign with a 13 10 defensive battle in a super bowl lx rematch much of the rest of the weekend however took a different path offensive explosions proved the norm caleb williams and the chicago bears dropped 59 points on the carolina panthers the franchise s most since the 1980 season and it s not as if carolina s offense was hapless attempting to keep up the panthers put 37 on the board contributing to the highest scoring week 1 game 96 combined points in league history lamar jackson s baltimore ravens scored 41 against the indianapolis colts while josh allen s buffalo bills required a similar output to defeat the houston texans 36 31 a somewhat shocking result considering demeco ryans club hasn t allowed that many points since his first year leading houston in 2023 the jacksonville jaguars opened a large enough lead that trevor lawrence sat out the fourth quarter of a 34 10 win over the cleveland browns and the minnesota vikings who defeated the green bay packers 39 22 at one point scored 22 points in 2 46 of game time during the fourth quarter the nfl s scoring frenzy stands in stark contrast to the commonly held belief that defenses typically begin the season ahead of offenses it was not so this week leading to record tying results

it was the bills superstar s fourth game with three plus passing and two plus rushing touchdowns joining kordell steward as the only players in nfl history with multiple such games a master of material_news_signals.headline: Bucs assistant on Baker Mayfield's past with Browns: 'They had the guy and they gave him up'
material_news_signals.description: Baker Mayfield and the Buccaneers face the Cleveland Browns on Sunday, marking the second time Mayfield will face his former team since he was traded in 2022.
material_news_signals.body_text: for the second time in his post cleveland career baker mayfield will face the browns this weekend this instance won t include a commemorative t shirt it will however include the only quarterback directly connected to mayfield s 2022 departure from cleveland deshaun watson sunday s contest in tampa fla will be the first opportunity for mayfield to face a watson led browns team since cleveland s pursuit of watson prompted mayfield to request and receive a trade to carolina in 2022 the outcome wasn t a simple swapping of homes and instant success for mayfield but with the benefit of five years worth of hindsight it s now clear who was the better option ken zampese current buccaneers senior offensive assistant and pass game coordinator spent time with mayfield in cleveland in 2018 and wasn t afraid to call it as he sees it prior to sunday s contest they had the guy zampese who was the browns quarterbacks coach in 2018 told espn they had the guy and they gave him up zampese s summary is accurate under coach kevin stefanski mayfield led the browns to their most successful stretch of play from 2018 2021 which included a playoff berth and the team s first postseason triumph since 1994 the high scoring wild card win over the steelers saw mayfield throw for 263 yards and three touchdowns powering a 48 37 win over the rival pittsburgh steelers in the steel city it s the high point of mayfield s tenure it s also the best memory for browns fans in the 21st century with any experience there s ups and downs good and bad mayfield said also via espn ultimately you remember the good more so than the bad the first time having a playoff win since 94 there and going on the road and doing it in pittsburgh so it s a lot of good memories there a lot of teammates that are friends for life the 2021 season wasn t as wonderful with expectations of building on their success mayfield and co arrived to more pressure in the ensuing season and when mayfield sustained a shoulder injury that likely should have sidelined him he s since admitted he shouldn t have continued playing he stubbornly stayed on the field for his team his performance suffered and after the browns missed the playoffs with an 8 9 finish cleveland s front office began to have a wandering eye their target watson who led the nfl in passing in 2020 but hadn t played football in 2021 after a trade request from houston and had been accused by more than 20 women of sexual misconduct during massage sessions once mayfield learned of cleveland s pursuit of watson he requested a trade mayfield landed in carolina where he began the 2022 season as the panthers starter with a week 1 game against cleveland jacoby brissett started in place of watson who was suspended for the first 11 games of that season and led the browns to a last second win over carolina and months later mayfield was released and landed with the los angeles rams where his career turnaround began those in cleveland still rue the day the browns began to pursue watson it s also fair to believe the mayfield stefanski partnership may have been doomed there were clues in the moment that the two were at odds which still hasn t been mended according to mayfield and as browns legend and former mayfield teammate joel bitonio explained it this week there likely wasn t enough to salvage between mayfield and the organization in 2022 you know we have this magical run and baker looks like the future of the team bitonio said during an appearance on espn cleveland 2021 we all know he s hurt right all the guys in the locker room everybody knows he s playing through this shoulder injury and things like that i told the team multiple times that i can play and baker has that same mindset and then behind the scenes you don t know what happens right as a player you only see so much i had nothing but respect for baker like i went to war with that guy he took us to the playoffs that thursday night win against the jets is still one of my fondest memories when he came into that game we won that game a lot of my happiest memories are with baker at quarterback i don t know what happened i still don t know what happened between him the ownership a b general manager andrew berry stefanski obviously it was unfixable mayfield meanwhile has moved on to greater success in tampa bay where he s won two nfc south titles and a playoff game with the buccaneers and where he recently signed his second lucrative extension and has made a home he s carrying all of us zampese said he just got rewarded for the job he s done and we all have great confidence in him doing an even better job as we move forward and i know he does too mayfield will receive his second opportunity to exact revenge on his former team sunday browns fans will do their best to cover their eyes

material_news_signals.headline: Seahawks rule out Sam Darnold for Week 2, don't plan to put QB on IR; Drew Lock to start vs. Cards
material_news_signals.description: Sam Darnold won't take the field in Week 2, but the outlook is promising. Darnold (glute) is not expected to land on injured reserve, Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald told reporters Wednesday.
material_news_signals.body_text: sam darnold won t take the field in week 2 but the outlook is promising darnold glute is not expected to land on injured reserve seahawks coach mike macdonald told reporters wednesday i don t anticipate putting him on ir or anything like that macdonald said but we ll just kind of re evaluate every day and re evaluate next week and we ll go from there but he won t play this week drew lock will start in place of darnold on sunday in arizona and jalen milroe will serve as the backup per macdonald darnold suffered what the seahawks called a very unique soft tissue injury to his glute just five snaps into seattle s season opening win over new england when he was sacked on third down limping off the field in obvious discomfort he did not return forcing lock into the game for what was eventually a comeback victory to start the campaign initially there were legitimate fears darnold had injured his hip but seattle clarified the qb s hip joint was not affected while adding there wasn t yet a firm timeline on darnold s return wednesday s update suggests darnold will be back within a month and allows the seahawks to take a week by week approach in the meantime lock will fill the starting job and aim to build on the strong finish he and the seahawks offense produced in week 1
